checks.title: Android target API
checks.recommendation: Verify the current Play target API requirement before submission.

checks.title: Android release signing
checks.recommendation: Configure a production keystore through CI secrets and remove the debug fallback.

testCases.title: Cold start and database initialization
preconditions: Fresh install or existing local database
testCases.expected: The app initializes local storage and renders a usable screen without a crash

testCases.title: Medication course and alarm policy
preconditions: Test medication with an optional course end date
steps: Evaluate an occurrence before and after its end date
testCases.expected: Occurrences after the course end are not scheduled

testCases.title: Prescription parsing and review
steps: Parse dosage, duration, and course dates
testCases.expected: Parsed values are editable and persisted only after confirmation

testCases.title: Camera and gallery permission denial
steps: Open prescription scan or medication photo
testCases.expected: The user receives an actionable error and the app remains usable

testCases.title: Release signing does not use debug credentials
preconditions: Configured production keystore in CI or local environment
testCases.expected: Release is signed with a production keystore and no debug fallback exists

testCases.title: Permission purpose and disclosure review
steps: Review camera, notifications, exact alarms, NFC, and medical-data disclosures
testCases.expected: Every permission has a user-facing purpose and matching store disclosure

testCases.title: Android release artifact
preconditions: Android SDK, production keystore, and dependencies
testCases.expected: A signed release artifact is produced without debug signing

testCases.title: iOS archive and signing
preconditions: macOS, Xcode, Pods, and signing credentials
testCases.expected: A valid signed archive is produced

limitations: iOS build/archive was not run because Xcode is unavailable on Linux.
Android release build requires production signing configuration before it can be a submission artifact.
Store metadata, privacy policy URL, Data Safety answers, and reviewer access require manual confirmation.
